whyItMatters: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an `environment.sdk` value of `any`.
actions: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix an `environment.sdk` value of `any`.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm pubspec.yaml no longer carries an `environment.sdk` value of `any`.
